name: BigQuery
description: Typed BigQuery datasets, tables, jobs, bounded query results, dry runs, explicit streaming inserts, routines, models and projects.

permissions.description: Explicit HTTPS BigQuery REST v2 calls at bigquery.googleapis.com with encrypted OAuth token. Confirmed effects include metadata changes, billable SQL jobs/queries, streaming rows, cancellation and deletes. Alternative tokenSecret needs host authorization. No filesystem/ambient credentials or automatic retries.

definitions.documentation: List BigQuery Projects: GET /projects. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. definitions.name: Get BigQuery Service Account
definitions.description: Get BigQuery Service Account
definitions.documentation: Get BigQuery Service Account: GET /projects/{projectId}/serviceAccount. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. definitions.documentation: List BigQuery Datasets: GET /projects/{projectId}/datasets. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. definitions.name: Create BigQuery Dataset
definitions.description: Create BigQuery Dataset
definitions.documentation: Create BigQuery Dataset: POST /projects/{projectId}/datasets. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=CREATE_DATASET. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. definitions.documentation: Patch BigQuery Dataset Metadata: PATCH /projects/{projectId}/datasets/{datasetId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=PATCH_DATASET. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. definitions.name: List BigQuery Tables
definitions.description: List BigQuery Tables
definitions.documentation: List BigQuery Tables: GET /projects/{projectId}/datasets/{datasetId}/tables. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. definitions.name: Create BigQuery Table
definitions.description: Create BigQuery Table
definitions.documentation: Create BigQuery Table: POST /projects/{projectId}/datasets/{datasetId}/tables. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=CREATE_TABLE. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. definitions.documentation: Patch BigQuery Table Metadata: PATCH /projects/{projectId}/datasets/{datasetId}/tables/{tableId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=PATCH_TABLE. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. definitions.name: List BigQuery Jobs
definitions.description: List BigQuery Jobs
definitions.documentation: List BigQuery Jobs: GET /projects/{projectId}/jobs. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. definitions.name: Submit BigQuery Query Job
definitions.description: Submit BigQuery Query Job
definitions.documentation: Submit BigQuery Query Job: POST /projects/{projectId}/jobs. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=SUBMIT_QUERY_JOB. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. definitions.name: Dry Run BigQuery Query
definitions.description: Dry Run BigQuery Query
definitions.documentation: Dry Run BigQuery Query: POST /projects/{projectId}/jobs. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. definitions.documentation: List BigQuery Table Rows: GET /projects/{projectId}/datasets/{datasetId}/tables/{tableId}/data. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating. Metadata patches are selected top-level nullable fields; null resets are passed exactly. No schema rewrite, storage-write API, export/load/copy jobs, model training, routine execution, continuous listener or live provider validation. definitions.name: Stream BigQuery Row Batch
definitions.description: Stream BigQuery Row Batch
definitions.documentation: Stream BigQuery Row Batch: POST /projects/{projectId}/datasets/{datasetId}/tables/{tableId}/insertAll. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=STREAM_INSERT. One bounded REST v2 HTTPS request to bigquery.googleapis.com. Explicit encrypted token secret BIGQUERY_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret contains externally issued OAuth token; issuance/refresh, API enablement, billing and operation-specific IAM permissions are external prerequisites. Scope bigquery or cloud-platform (bigquery.readonly for eligible reads). No ADC, service-account files, ambient credentials or token refresh. Retries must be zero, including queries and reads; no polling, replay, automatic next page or workload execution during build/tests. 10s default/30s maximum transport deadline covers secret lookup through body streaming; independent 250ms cleanup and reader-lock release. Request 256KiB, response 1MiB, page/batch max100; maxResults is explicit or defaults100, opaque pagination remains manual. Query settings force GoogleSQL and explicit maximumBytesBilled; SQL can perform DDL/DML and incur charges. A jobs.insert submission requires caller-chosen jobReference; reconcile uncertain outcomes with Get Job using the same project/location/jobId. The dry-run operation forces configuration.dryRun=true, accepts the synchronous validation response with processing statistics without requiring asynchronous job status or configuration echo, rejects explicit errorResult or contradictory dryRun=false, and reports noExecution=true only after validation; dry runs validate/estimate without executing SQL, are not a guarantee of later cost, permission or success. Query once may return PENDING and a jobReference: retrieve results separately; DONE/ERROR remain distinct. Job cancellation is a request and may not stop completed effects. Job status.errorResult is terminal failure; status.errors can be nonfatal diagnostics. Query response errors can include warnings: a completed response with diagnostics yields DONE_WITH_DIAGNOSTICS, not a success/failure conclusion. Get Job status.errorResult establishes terminal failure. Streaming insert reports per-row failed indices and unreported indices; unreported is not exactly-once delivery proof. insertId is best-effort deduplication only; skipInvalidRows=false may leave otherwise-valid rows uninserted. No automatic retry. Row f/cell v order, repeated/record JSON, nulls and exact string precision survive; no coercion of INT64/NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC/BYTES. Caller-defined row JSON values are dynamic; callers must encode wide numbers/bytes per table schema. Known metadata fields are typed and selected; unsupported fields are omitted rather than claimed as complete provider resources. Schema nesting supports four field levels, parameter nesting three levels; deeper RECORD input/output fails explicitly rather than truncating.
